title: OS1 theme
description: A skin for the OS1 phone app. One file per customer org (or per niche starter kit). Only the eight required tokens must be supplied; every other token is derived from them at runtime by public/js/theme-core.js.

spec.description: Contract version. Bump only on a breaking change to the token set.

id.description: Stable slug. Also the filename (<id>.json) and the value of ?theme=.

name.description: Human name of the palette itself, not the business.

tagline.description: One short line describing the look. Shown in tooling, never in the app.

app_name.description: Overrides the wordmark, the document title, and the installed app's name. Omit to keep OS1.

logo.description: Optional wordmark replacement. Must be same-origin: a remote URL is rejected at runtime so a themed install never calls off-box.

dark.description: Optional. When present the app follows the phone's appearance setting; when absent the light palette is used in both.

accessibility.description: Recorded result of scripts/check-theme-contrast.mjs. Informational: the checker is the authority, not this block.

color.description: Hex or rgb()/rgba(). Anything else is dropped at runtime.

surface.description: The page background. Every screen sits on this.

brand.description: The hero fill. Cards, the top bar, tickets. Must carry on-brand text at 4.5:1.

brand-strong.description: Pressed and active states, and the active tab label on surface. Must reach 4.5:1 on surface.

on-surface.description: Body ink on surface. Warm near-black beats pure black.

on-surface-secondary.description: Derived: on-surface flattened, then 72 percent alpha.

on-surface-muted.description: Derived: on-surface flattened, then 50 percent alpha. Carries real 11px and 13px text, so it is contrast-checked like body copy.

on-brand.description: Ink on the brand fill. Usually near-white.

on-brand-muted.description: Derived: on-brand at 50 percent alpha. Non-text (the idle status dot).

overlay.description: Derived: hairline borders and insets, on-surface at 18 percent.

success.description: Connected dot. Non-text, needs 3:1 against brand.

warning.description: Error dot and the offline banner fill.

tabbar-bg.description: Derived: surface at 92 percent, blurred over content.

on-warning.description: Derived: whichever of the theme's dark or light ink reads better on the warning fill.
